title: Japan Romance Trail | Snow, Shrine & Skyline
highlights: Embark on a captivating journey across Japan, where ancient shrines, modern marvels, breathtaking landscapes, and vibrant cityscapes weave together an unforgettable story.
Admire the beauty of Nikko Toshogu Shrine, a UNESCO treasure adorned with gold leaf and intricate carvings, honoring the legacy of shogun Tokugawa Ieyasu.
Step into the volcanic beauty of Noboribetsu’s Hell Valley, where steaming vents, bubbling pools, and sulfur streams reveal nature’s fierce, untamed power.
Indulge in world-class shopping at Gotemba Premium Outlets, Japan’s largest outlet mall, where over 200 brands meet sweeping views of the majestic Mt. Fuji.
Witness the tradition of the Osaka Sumo Show, showcasing Japan’s national sport with thrilling bouts, rich cultural rituals, and an up-close look at sumo’s centuries-old heritage.
overview:
About the Tour:
Embark on a captivating journey through Japan, the Land of the Rising Sun, blending ancient traditions with modern wonders. Begin in Tokyo, exploring sacred sites like Meiji Jingu Shrine, the historic Imperial Palace, and the vibrant streets of Ginza and Shibuya. Cruise along the city’s waterways and discover the spiritual charm of Sensoji Temple. Continue to Hokkaido, where the rainbow-hued flower fields of Farm Tomita and the lavender-scented air offer pure serenity. Marvel at the dramatic geothermal landscapes of Noboribetsu’s Hell Valley, and explore its charming towns and serene lakes. Return south to marvel at Mt. Fuji from the 5th Station, shop at Gotemba Premium Outlets, and glide over Hakone’s volcanic valleys before sailing Lake Ashi. Conclude in Osaka with the thrills of Universal Studios Japan, where unforgettable rides, parades, and movie magic bring your journey to an exhilarating close.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

Thrillophilia's visa policy emphasizes that the company is not liable or responsible for any issues related to visa applications. This includes situations where a visa is rejected or delayed, or if there are any delays or errors in the documentation process. The responsibility and control over visa matters lie solely with the respective embassy.
Images are for representation purpose only.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan, the Land of the Rising Sun! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the day at leisure, where you can experience Tokyo’s vibrant spirit by strolling through the upscale Ginza district filled with luxury brands and fine dining. Also, you can witness a live samurai performance that brings Japan’s warrior era to life or feel the electric buzz at the legendary Shibuya Crossing, known for its amazing vibe.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin the day by heading to Love Sculpture in Shinjuku & board the bus for Tokyo city tour. Pass stunning landmarks like towering Godzilla Head in Kabukicho & the stately National Diet Building. Also, see neon-lit tech hub of Akihabara, lively Ameyoko Market & Kappabashi Dougu Street, famed for its kitchenware. Later, visit the historic Meiji Jingu Shrine & admire the grand Kaminarimon Gate of Sensoji Temple. Later, get driven to Shinjuku St. West Exit. From these, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: In the morning, head to Shinjuku Center Building & board your transfer to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, where stunning views of Japan’s iconic mountain ranges await. Then, enjoy shopping at Gotemba Premium Outlets, home to top international brands. Continue to Hakone for a ropeway ride over volcanic Ōwakudani Valley, offering a surreal landscape. Later, enjoy a scenic pirate ship cruise across Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, return to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Transfer to Sapporo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Tokyo Station & board the iconic Shinkansen (Bullet Train) for a high-speed journey to Hokkaido. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel & upon arrival, check in. Later, you can spend the day at your leisure. You can visit the historic Sapporo Clock Tower, a symbol of the city’s heritage. Alternatively, you can visit the Hill of the Buddha, where a serene statue is surrounded by sea. You may also stroll through Tanukikoji Shopping Street, lined with shops & eateries.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Dormy Inn PREMIUM Sapporo

days.title: Trip to Furano Tomita Farm, Shikisai Hill, Blue Pond & Campana Rokkatei
days.desc: Today, head to the ANA Crowne Plaza Sapporo 1F Lobby & board your transfer for the Furano sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to Farm Tomita, where lavender blooms in July paint the hills in purple hues, & marvel at the surreal cobalt tones of the Blue Pond. Also, stroll through the colorful Four Seasons Color Hill with over 30 flower varieties & enjoy sweet Hokkaido treats at Campana Rokkatei. Later, get driven to JR Sapporo Station North Exit & from there, return to your hotel.

items.title: Trip to Furano Tomita Farm, Shikisai Hill, Blue Pond & Campana Rokkatei

days.title: Tour to Lake Toya, Showa-shinzan & Jigokudani Volcano Valley
days.desc: Today, head to Sapporo St. North Exit Bus Stop & board the bus for an amazing journey. Explore Lake Toya, a caldera lake surrounded by volcanic landscapes. Then, visit Showa-Shinzan region, where you can ride Usuzan Ropeway for panoramic views or visit nearby bear ranch for a close look at Hokkaido’s wildlife. Continue to Jigokudani (Hell Valley), home to steaming vents & bubbling hot springs. Later, get driven back to Sapporo St. North Exit Bus Stop. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Day Tour to Lake Toya, Showa-shinzan & Jigokudani Volcano Valley

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Osaka Sumo Show Experience
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight to Osaka. On arrival, get driven to your hotel and check in. Later, head to the Sumo Restaurant for a unique cultural evening featuring the Osaka Sumo Show. Once there, enjoy a hearty bowl of chanko nabe, the traditional stew favored by sumo wrestlers. Also, get the chance to step into the ring yourself and explore fascinating exhibits, including authentic sumo attire worn by the legendary Konishiki, the first foreign-born Ozeki.

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, embark on a fun-filled adventure to Universal Studios Japan, one of Asia’s premier theme parks where movies leap off the screen. Once at the park, dive into thrilling attractions inspired by Harry Potter, Jurassic Park, Minions, and Spider-Man. Wander through the magical Wizarding World of Harry Potter, soar on the Flying Dinosaur coaster, and enjoy dazzling parades and live shows—turning every moment into a cinematic experience. Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: This morning, check out from your Osaka hotel and get driven to Kansai International Airport for your flight home. As you depart, cherish the memories of your romantic Japanese journey—from serene shrines and breathtaking landscapes to vibrant city thrills. Though your couple’s getaway concludes, the moments you’ve shared and the adventures you’ve experienced will remain etched in your hearts forever.
